title: Using the warehouse without losing stock
target: How to keep stock in the warehouse in TCG Card Shop Simulator, given that the game has a shelf type of its own for the back room, tracks those shelves apart from the shop's, and can store boxes unopened.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Shelves bought for the back room
Stock you do not want on the shop floor yet
An idea of what the shop needs today

steps.do: Buy the shelf type the warehouse expects rather than any shelf.
steps.because: the warehouse has a shelf type of its own (WarehouseShelf)

steps.do: Mark the things that should only ever live back there.
steps.because: an object can be marked as belonging in the warehouse (m_PlaceObjectInWarehouseOnly)

steps.do: Count back-room shelves separately from the shop's.
steps.because: warehouse shelves are tracked apart from the shop's shelves (m_WarehouseShelfList, m_WarehouseShelfSaveDataList)

steps.do: Leave stock boxed when you do not need it opened yet.
steps.because: stock can be stored boxed rather than unpacked (isBoxed, boxedPackagePos)

steps.do: Move a shelf only where the game shows it may go.
steps.because: the game shows where a shelf may legally be moved (ShelfMoveStateValidArea)

commonMistakes: Unboxing everything and then needing the boxes back.
Mixing back-room shelves with shop shelves when counting what you own.
Moving a shelf and assuming its saved contents move with it.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
